question: In its reply to my previous question, the Commission states that Croatia fulfilled thematic enabling condition 2.6 of Annex IV to Regulation (EU) 2021/10601 on 15 March 2024, but does not clarify whether this assessment considered the actual performance and effectiveness of Croatia’s waste management system beyond the formal existence of the required planning framework. 1.

Can the Commission clarify whether, when assessing the fulfilment of thematic enabling condition 2.6, it examined not only the existence and formal compliance of Croatia’s waste management plan, but also its effective implementation and the actual performance of the waste management system, including recycling rates, the proportion of municipal waste sent to landfill and the financial sustainability of waste management infrastructure?

If these aspects were not part of the assessment, how does the Commission ensure that the fulfilment of the enabling condition reflects the actual capacity of the Member State to meet EU waste management objectives, rather than the mere existence of a formally compliant plan? Does the Commission intend to reassess Croatia’s fulfilment of condition 2.6 in the light of its continued shortcomings in waste management?
